lead: A `## Next group` anchor under `website/` is refused as no anchor at all.
body: `ANCHOR_RE` in `tools/nv/cmd/orient.ts` admits only paths under `crates`, `tools`, `tests`, `benches`, `examples`, `fuzz`, `docs` and `editors`, so `website/astro.config.ts:27` fails the wrap. Anchor the item on the in-tree file the website work reads from, and name the `website/` path in plain words beside it.
